name: Citizen Pain
description:
About This Game

Citizen Pain is a single-player dark fantasy action game with first-person melee combat inspired by classic old-school titles. Built from the ground up in Unreal Engine by a solo developer, it blends nostalgic gameplay with modern visuals and a strong narrative core.

Catherina, a young warrior, embarks on a desperate quest to challenge the Undead King, a tyrant who promises salvation through monstrous transformation. Armed with his sword and sorrow, Catherina must battle corrupted knights, traverse cursed lands, and confront the fading soul of a dying world.

Citizen Pain captures the essence of traditional single-player experiences while offering a skill-based challenge that rewards mastery and precision.

Game Features

  • Brutal first-person melee combat with multiple special weapons to discover and wield

  • A mysterious, dangerous world to explore: from ruined villages to ancient catacombs, caverns, and beyond

  • A wide variety of enemies and end-of-level bosses, each with distinct fighting styles, strengths, and weaknesses

  • An epic, atmospheric soundtrack with unique themes for each level and boss

  • A hauntingly beautiful world crafted with Unreal Engine 5
short_desc: Citizen Pain is a first-person dark fantasy action game. Play as Catherina, warrior princess of the Moges Empire, who gains the supernatural force known as Pain and leads the fight against the Undead King. Classic single-player combat meets modern visuals in this skill-based indie experience.
